name: When is it time to invest in a full interior paint package rather than minor touch-ups?

mainEntity.name: When is it time to invest in a full interior paint package rather than minor touch-ups?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should plan for a full repaint if you notice widespread fading, scuffs that do not wash off, peeling trim, or visible settling cracks across multiple rooms. It is also recommended when moving into a newly purchased house, updating out-of-style color palettes, or restoring rental and foreclosed properties. If you have recently completed remodeling work—such as reconfiguring walls, replacing kitchen cabinets, or updating doors—a complete package ties old and new spaces together so the entire floor plan looks cohesive.
acceptedAnswer.description: Invest in a full repaint when you have widespread wall wear, recent remodeling changes, outdated colors throughout, or settling cracks that touch-ups cannot hide.
